Plaid personal finance category taxonomy
Retrieved: 2026-10-23

v1 list, 104 detailed codes:
https://plaid.com/documents/transactions-personal-finance-category-taxonomy.csv
File: transactions-personal-finance-category-taxonomy.csv

v2 list, 127 detailed codes:
https://plaid.com/documents/pfc-taxonomy-all.csv
File: pfc-taxonomy-all.csv

Documentation:
https://plaid.com/docs/api/products/transactions/

The v2 file is the combined taxonomy. Its first data row is a note, not a category.
Three detailed codes were renamed from v1 to v2:
INCOME_WAGES to INCOME_SALARY
INCOME_OTHER_INCOME to INCOME_OTHER
TRANSFER_IN_CASH_ADVANCES_AND_LOANS to LOAN_DISBURSEMENTS_OTHER_DISBURSEMENT

The v2 row OTHER_OTHER lists a v1 detailed cell of
TRANSFER_IN_OTHER_TRANSFER_IN / TRANSFER_OUT_OTHER_TRANSFER_OUT.
That slash string is not a category code. Both transfer codes remain their own rows.
